div.div: نَبْخَآءُ A hill, or mound, such as is called أَكَمَة: (S:) or elevated ground: (TA:) or elevated and loose ground, not consisting of sand, but of hard and stony earth: (Th, K:) pl. نَبَاخَى: (K:) it has a broken pl. of the class proper to substs. because it is an epithet in which the quality of a subst. predominates. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
